outcome: No unresolved record was promoted on identity-only or partial-skill evidence. This gate prevents accidental row-order inference and keeps the canonical producer conservative.
next: Continue searching remaining unresolved families for sources that explicitly bind preset number to a complete eight-slot configuration; prioritize first-party/maintained reference tables over community unlock-only videos.
